Trap: the repository shares one file between agents with a symlink CLAUDE.md -> AGENTS.md. Checked out by git on Windows without symlink support (core.symlinks false, the default there), the link becomes a 9-byte plain file whose whole text is `AGENTS.md`. Claude Code reads that as a CLAUDE.md: it counts, so AGENTS.md is switched off, and one bare path is not an import, so AGENTS.md never arrives (rule claude.symlink). repo/CLAUDE.md here is exactly what git writes in that case.
